description: Unit tests for the microdump_writer component of the breakpad crash reporting library, including tests for microdump content and metadata handling.

classes.name: MicrodumpExtraInfo
classes.description: Data structure holding extra info for microdump, such as build fingerprint, product info, and GPU fingerprint.

classes.name: MappingInfo
classes.description: Structure representing a memory mapping info.

classes.name: MappingEntry
classes.description: A pair of MappingInfo and GUID representing a memory mapping.

methods.name: MakeMicrodumpExtraInfo
methods.description: Creates a MicrodumpExtraInfo object with specified build fingerprint, product info, and GPU fingerprint.

methods.name: CrashAndGetMicrodump
methods.description: Simulates a crash, generates a microdump, and retrieves its content for testing.

methods.name: CheckMicrodumpContents
methods.description: Verifies that the microdump content contains expected metadata and structure.
